title: Ambient scalar forgetting admits a strong monoidal structure
statement: Let l be prime and Y any scheme. Let U=AdicSheaf.forgetAb l Y be the scalar-forgetting functor of [lem-sf-native-scalar-forgetting-equivalence]. Equip its source and target module categories with the ordinary relative tensor of [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor]. Then Nonempty U.Monoidal: the existing functor U admits a strong monoidal structure. This assertion is entirely underived and contains no representative complexes or arbitrary closed structures.

proof.text: Let F be free ambient modules on abelian sheaves, G its lax monoidal forgetful right adjoint, and B the native coefficient algebra. Apply F.mapMod to modules over G(B), and then extend scalars along the counit F(G(B)) to B. The first functor is strong monoidal by [def-sfb-mapmod-strong-monoidal]; the second by [lem-sfb-internal-extension-monoidal]. Their composite L is strong monoidal.

Compose the lifted free-forgetful adjunction [def-sfb-modobj-transport-adjunction] with extension-restriction adjunction [def-sfb-modobj-extend-restrict-adjunction]. On the right, mapMod commutes with comap; the two restriction maps compose to the identity by the right triangle equation. This gives L left adjoint to U. By [lem-sf-native-scalar-forgetting-equivalence], U is an equivalence, hence L is an equivalence. Its inverse has the inverse monoidal structure (Mathlib Equivalence.inverseMonoidal), and uniqueness of right adjoints identifies this inverse with U. Transport that monoidal structure along this isomorphism. The monoidal structure on scalar extension is supplied by its already proved theorem; this construction introduces no new proof hole.
